facts.fact: Zane 把 Caroline 带去马厩，教她经营买卖；到本章为止，她的净利已超过一百五十美元。
facts.anchor: I took her back to the stables. And I helped her build up quite a stock portfolio. So far, her net profit was over one hundred and fifty dollars.

facts.fact: Zane 私下祈求上帝：愿 Caroline 拿这笔钱跟 Grey 离婚，到别处重新开始。
facts.anchor: Please god, let her use that money to divorce Grey and start over somewhere fresh.

facts.fact: Zane 犹豫要不要把 Orson 夸耀自己逛妓院、并把那里的女孩绑起来打伤的事告诉 Caroline。
facts.anchor: Should I tell her how he bragged about visiting bordellos where he’d tie up and bruise the girls who worked there?

facts.fact: Zane 还犹豫要不要说出他曾亲眼看见 Orson 在同一个下午踢打一条小狗和一个孩子。
facts.anchor: Should I tell her of the time I saw him kick both a small dog and a small child in the same afternoon?

facts.fact: Zane 终于向 Caroline 承认自己在别人面前无法进食，因为他右侧脸部肌肉已经不能正常运作，吃东西既困难又难看。
facts.anchor: “I cannot eat in front of other people,” I blurted.

facts.fact: Caroline 在野餐前就定下今天要弄清 Zane 到底知道 Orson 的哪些事；她认为 Orson 虽无疤却餐桌礼仪糟糕，Zane 至少不会克扣她的食物。
facts.anchor: Besides, I’d decided today was the day. No matter what else, I would get to the bottom of what Zane knew about Orson.

facts.fact: Zane 承认自己正在掂量该告诉 Caroline 多少，并说 Caroline 并不想听全部真相——她仍坚持要听。
facts.anchor: “I am debating how much to tell you.”

facts.fact: Zane 明确否认工厂爆炸是意外：Orson 是蓄意引发那场爆炸来除掉他。
Zane 拿出物证：Orson 那天清早就在工厂，且对警方否认过；木头内侧硬化的白色物质与刺鼻气味是纵火者惯用的“芬尼亚火”痕迹。
facts.anchor: “He was at the mill early that morning, even though he told the police he hadn’t been there. It was definitely him.”

facts.fact: 那场爆炸造成四个人死亡，Zane 自己差点成为第五个死者。
听完真相，Caroline 崩溃大哭，扑进 Zane 的怀里。
facts.anchor: I burst into tears and threw myself into Zane’s arms.
